  • Configuration and quote comparison
  • Commercial term review

Deployment support

Infrastructure consulting

  • Networking, storage and cluster requirements
  • Growth and expansion review

Process

How we work

Configuration, commercial terms and delivery plans are agreed step by step. It is fine if some details are still taking shape.

Engagement stages, what you provide, what we do and what you receive
Stage What you provide What we do What you receive
01 Brief Workload, GPU preference, region, rental term and timeline. Clarify the requirement and flag gaps or trade-offs worth deciding early. A written requirements summary.
02 Sourcing Feedback on configuration and commercial trade-offs. Approach suppliers and compare configurations, scope and terms. Comparable quotes, with the differences set out.
03 Handoff A decision and your internal technical contacts. Coordinate access, dependencies and delivery milestones with the provider. A delivery plan and a defined provider handoff.

Scope

Scope and limitations

Stated plainly so there is no ambiguity about what an engagement does and does not include.

Included

  • Supplier identification, approach and comparison
  • Configuration and capacity review against your workload
  • Comparison of commercial terms and rental structures
  • Deployment coordination and provider handoff
  • Input on networking, storage and cluster requirements

Not included

  • Dataorb Cloud does not own or operate data centers
  • We do not hold GPU inventory or reserve capacity
  • Availability, pricing and delivery timing are confirmed by the supplier, not guaranteed here
  • No financial, legal or tax advice
  • Published specifications are reference figures, not an offer

FAQ

Before we get started

What does Dataorb Cloud do?

We help customers define GPU compute requirements, compare supplier options and coordinate deployment. Our role and the selected provider’s responsibilities are clarified during the quotation process.

Do you own the GPUs or operate the data center?

Our current services focus on sourcing and coordination with third-party providers. Each proposal identifies the supplier and clarifies who provides the hardware, hosting and operational support.

Can you help plan a dedicated GPU cluster?

Yes. We can help organize requirements for GPU configuration, networking, storage and hosting, and coordinate discussions with prospective providers. Detailed engineering and delivery scope are agreed for each project.

How are pricing and availability confirmed?

Pricing and availability depend on the configuration, location, rental term and supplier. They are confirmed during quoting; GPU options shown on this website are reference configurations, not a live inventory listing.

How long does deployment take?

Timing depends on supplier availability, configuration, hosting readiness and project scope. The delivery schedule is agreed with the selected provider during quoting. We do not promise immediate activation.

Who provides ongoing support?

Support responsibilities, coverage hours, escalation contacts and any service commitments are defined in the proposal and the relevant provider agreements.
